name: TrackMania Nations Forever
notes: Use the dedicated DirectX 9 Metal path with TrackMania's tuned audio and scene settings. The OpenGL fallback is available if rendering fails, but can be considerably slower. Performance varies by hardware and track.

name: Counter-Strike 2
notes: Use DXMT for CS2's DirectX 11 graphics. The combined DirectX 9–11 profile also includes this backend. The tuned preset reaches around 60 FPS on the tested M4, with periodic drops. The owner confirmed online matchmaking in a clean Steam environment, followed by a VAC signature error after crossedover's launch setup. Restoring Steam's normal overlay handling is under test; secure matchmaking and sustained performance still need confirmation with this configuration.
